sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:24

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:24:1
items.html: Four lacks of the light, which itself will cause an appellation of the name in the upper light, so that it can be called by the name HaVaYaH: This means that the secret of the letters is vessels that were emanated and made by means of the sparks that fell from the reflected light of the four levels which emerged at the time of the departure of the light of the first expansion, and came into the empty vessels after the departure of the light from them. As has been explained in the words of the ARI above, Part 4, Chapter 3, item 12 (and see in the Inner Light there, item 100). And every “name” means an attainment, for what we do not attain we do not know by a name. And it is known that there is no attainment in a light without a vessel; it has also been explained in the words of the ARI above (Part 4, Chapter 1, item 9): “for the cause of the expansion of the light and its departure afterward brought about the making of the existence of a vessel.” Behold, that the lacks of the light cause the existence of the coming into being of the vessels and of the holy names. And this is what he says: “in the nine Sefirot there are in them four lacks of the light, which itself will cause an appellation of the name in the upper light, so that it can be called by the name HaVaYaH” — that is, that there be a possibility of attaining it by this name. And understand this.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:24:2
items.html: The expansion of the light one time, etc., and behold this is one lack in the first expansion in nine vessels. That is to say, at the time when the light began to expand in Keter, the expansion was in the aspect of direct light and mercy; and then all the nine below it were lacking that complete light. And although they emerged afterward at the time of the departure, in the four degrees the screen made in the course of its refinement, as is known, nevertheless they are discerned as reflected light and judgement, and they are therefore called by the name Nekudot. And therefore there is here a lack in the nine lower ones of the first expansion. But there is here no lack whatever in Keter, and therefore Keter is not alluded to in the letters of the name HaVaYaH, they being in the secret of the lack of the light, as above. Rather, the expansion of the nine Sefirot below Keter, which are the four levels Hochma, Bina, ZON, that emerged in the secret of reflected light and judgement, is the secret of the Yod of HaVaYaH. And the departure of the whole first expansion in its entirety is the secret of the Hey of HaVaYaH. And they are called the Yod-Hey of Keter, for the whole first expansion is called Keter.
